name: Miscellania and Etceteria Dungeon
accessNote: The dungeon beneath Miscellania and Etceteria, entered during and after Royal Trouble. It houses the Sea snake hatchling and Sea snake young Slayer monsters. The area is single combat but a dwarf multicannon may be used; the blue eggs halfway through the tunnel serve as a safespot. Sea snakes are poisonous, so an antipoison is recommended.
